changes.source: Stored in 'n'. Marvel Database (via WebSearch summaries; fandom not fetchable) files the 2026 live-action Spider-Noir series (Ben Reilly) under Earth-TRN1832 and says it is a different reality from Earth-90214 and from the Into the Spider-Verse Noir. Wikipedia 'Multiverse (Marvel Comics)' gives Earth-90214 as the Marvel Noir comics reality that the series was 'adapted' from. One summary also named 'Earth-62533' as an official name, but no other source confirms it.

Stored in 'n'. Marvel Database (via WebSearch summaries) gives Earth-86445 for the Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man animated series and its prequel comic. It replaced Earth-TRN1450 and the Database calls it an official number, but no Marvel publication was found that states it. The other Spider-Verse places already put the Earth number in 'n'.

Stored in 'n'. Wikipedia 'Multiverse (Marvel Comics)' gives Earth-6799 as the setting of the 1967 Spider-Man series and says the designation Earth-67 'is instead used for the comic book version of this reality'. Marvel Database episode pages also use Earth-6799 (via WebSearch). Against this, Into the Spider-Verse labels this world 'Earth-67' on screen, and the app uses Earth-67 in the timeline era label and in the Miguel O'Hara record line. Owner's call.

Consistency: every other incursion whose title has a year uses 'Title · year' (Fantastic Four · 1967, Fantastic Four · 2015, Iron Man · 1994). The year also tells this Corman film (Earth-94000) apart from the 1994 animated Fantastic Four (Earth-534834).
Consistency: the title is 'Hulk (2003)', and every other dated title uses the 'Title · year' label pattern.
